I answer common questions about IUBAT: admission requirements and dates, programs, scholarships, fees, campus location and contact details.

IUBAT stands for International University of Business Agriculture and Technology, a private university in Uttara, Dhaka. It is approved by the Government of Bangladesh and its curricula are approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC).
IUBAT was founded by Prof Dr M Alimullah Miyan. Planning began in 1989 and it was established in 1991, making it the first private university in Bangladesh.
The permanent campus is at 4 Embankment Drive Road (off Dhaka-Ashulia Road), Sector 10, Uttara Model Town, Dhaka 1230, on the bank of the river Turag.
The IUBAT campus covers about 20 bighas of river-view land in Uttara, surrounded by greenery. A Bangladesh National Cadet Corps (BNCC) platoon is active on campus.

Undergraduate programs include BBA, BATHM (Tourism and Hospitality Management), BSME (Mechanical Engineering), BSAg (Agriculture), BSEEE (Electrical and Electronic Engineering), BSN (Nursing), BAEcon (Economics), BCSE (Computer Science and Engineering) and BSCE (Civil Engineering). IUBAT also offers graduate programs such as the MBA. See iubat.edu/admission for the current full list.
Yes. IUBAT offers the BCSE (Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering) under its engineering programs.

questions: does iubat offer a masters program
answer: Yes. IUBAT offers graduate programs, including the MBA. Graduate fees and admission details are on iubat.edu/admission.

questions: how long is the undergraduate program
how many years is the bachelor program
answer: The 4-year undergraduate programs run for 12 semesters, with three semesters in each academic year.
At the moment there is no evening program for undergraduate students.

IUBAT is approved by the Government of Bangladesh and its curricula are approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC). Some of its programs have membership of The Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh (IEB).

questions: what do i need to apply
answer: You need an HSC or equivalent (twelve years of formal education). The admission page lists a minimum combined GPA of 6.00 out of 9.00. You must then pass the admission test and complete the admission formalities.

questions: can i apply for engineering with commerce
answer: Engineering programs require Science in HSC or equivalent, with Higher Mathematics (passing grade).

questions: o level and a level eligibility
answer: GCE candidates need 2 'A' Levels and 5 'O' Levels, with a minimum of four 'B' grades and three 'C' grades, for bachelor's programs.

questions: how does the admission test work
do i need to sit an exam
answer: Apply with the admission form, then appear for the IUBAT undergraduate written test and interview. Students who pass and meet the requirements complete admission formalities and pay the required fees.

For Fall 2026, the undergraduate deadline was 5 August 2026 and the written test was on 7 August 2026 at 10:00 AM. Dates change each semester, so check iubat.edu/admission or email admissions@iubat.edu for the latest circular.

questions: where can i get the admission form
answer: The admission form is available at the IUBAT Admission Office on working days between 8:30 AM and 8:00 PM, and there is an online form on iubat.edu/admission. An Initial Admission Form is available free of charge.

questions: what documents are needed for admission
do i need a photo for the form
answer: The application form needs a passport-size colored photograph. The full list of documents required for final admission is on iubat.edu/admission.
International students can apply. The admission processing charge for international students is US $20.
Fees depend on your program and on the merit scholarship you receive. See iubat.edu/student/tuition-and-fees for the current table, or ask the admission office.

questions: how can i get a scholarship
answer: IUBAT offers scholarships and financial aid in several categories, including the Merit Scholarship, the Founder Dr Miyan Scholarship and the IUBAT Green Leaf Scholarship. Continuing a scholarship requires satisfactory academic performance. More at iubat.edu/scholarships.

questions: is there a scholarship for female students
answer: Yes. A female student gets an additional 15% scholarship on tuition over male students.
Continuation of scholarship or financial aid is subject to satisfactory academic performance.

questions: how can i contact the admission office
where can i send my queries
answer: You can reach the admission office by email at admissions@iubat.edu.
Admission information is always posted on the official website: www.iubat.edu/admission.
